name: Poisoned Spines
body:
Much like your far-off savage ancestors, your spines have a powerful poison.

Prerequisite(s): Nemean, spine shot racial trait, 7th level.

Benefit(s): When you deal damage to a creature with your spine shot, the target must also save against manticore poison. Elephants, and elephant-esque creatures (GM’s discretion), are immune to manticore poison.

Manticore Poison: injury; save Fort DC 10 + 1/2 level + Con modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d3 Str damage; cure 1 save.
